scope: Prevent confirmed default same-model ambient/foreground runner context churn without changing lane behavior or clinical rules.

condition.model: Exact nonempty string equality: request.model == config.AMBIENT_LLM_MODEL == config.LLM_MODEL.
condition.other_contexts: Absent, non-integer, unfamiliar, already8192 and larger explicit contexts are unchanged.
condition.mutation: New payload and options dictionaries; caller-owned values preserved.

unchanged: Prompts, system/messages, format, output budgets, sampling temperatures and keep_alive.
Client timeouts, queue priorities/admission, background gates, yielding and safety/clinical policy.
Models-off refusal remains before context normalization, request dispatch or audit.
Separate ambient-model contexts, including4096 for narrator/projection and2048 for room-fit.
Streaming/provider seams and unrelated gateway purposes.
verification: Captured fake HTTP requests cover all5 purposes and both existing contexts across /api/chat and /api/generate.
Negative cases cover distinct configured models, requested-model mismatch, near-match tags, empty/missing model, unrelated purpose and absent/unfamiliar/larger windows.
Original request dictionaries/options remain unchanged, and audit receives the dispatched payload with identical prompt hash.
Real narrator/projection call paths run in shared and distinct configurations and preserve output budgets.
Existing audit, yield/cancellation and gateway source guards remain green.
limits: Only synthetic captured HTTP/model responses were used; no actual inference, model loading or network request was run.
Focused tests establish dispatch/gate behavior, not latency improvement, output quality or clinical acceptance. Root owns the later full suite and measured browser timing.
No live environment, database, uploads, backups or model weights were accessed or modified.
